National Commission for Minorities Opens Offline Application for Principal Private Secretary Post in New Delhi

Overview of the NCM Recruitment 2026

The National Commission for Minorities (NCM) in New Delhi has issued an official notification inviting applications for the post of Principal Private Secretary under Advertisement Number F.No. 2-1/2025-Estt. The recruitment is conducted on a deputation basis, and interested candidates must submit their applications offline through the proper channel.

The designated workplace for the position is New Delhi. The selected candidate will be placed in Pay Level-11, with a salary range spanning from Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 208,700. The deadline for applications to reach the organization is December 27, 2026.

Eligibility Criteria and Qualifications

The position is open to officers currently serving in the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territory Administrations, public sector undertakings, universities, recognized research institutions, semi-government bodies, autonomous bodies, or statutory organizations. Eligible candidates must either hold analogous posts on a regular basis in their parent cadre or department, or possess specific years of regular service in designated pay levels:

  • Five years of regular service in Level-10 (Rs. 56,100–177,500)
  • Six years of regular service in Level-8 (Rs. 47,600–151,000)
  • Seven years of regular service in Level-7 (Rs. 44,900–142,400)

Additionally, the maximum age limit for applicants is set at 56 years as of the closing date for the receipt of applications. Departmental officers in the feeder category who fall directly in the line of promotion are not eligible for consideration under deputation.

Terms of Engagement and Selection Process

Appointments will initially be made for a period of one year, which may be extended further, though the total period of deputation shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

The selection process involves evaluation through the proper channel followed by an assessment by a Selection Committee at the time of final selection.

Application Procedure and Requirements

Candidates must apply offline. The application packet must include:

  • The completed application form sent through the proper channel
  • Attested copies of Annual Confidential Reports (ACR) or Annual Performance Assessment Reports (APAR) for the last five years
  • Vigilance clearance, an Integrity Certificate, and a penalty statement for the last five years, alongside vigilance clearance and an Integrity Certificate for the last ten years
  • Clear indications of the applicant's email address and mobile number

The notification specifies no application fee. Completed applications must reach the National Commission for Minorities, Block-14, 1st Floor, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003 by December 27, 2026.

Practical Implications and Verification

Applicants currently in government or public sector service must plan their submissions well in advance to accommodate routing applications through the proper channel before the December 27, 2026 deadline. Because missing documentation—such as ACR/APAR copies or vigilance certificates—can disqualify an application, candidates should carefully verify all checklist requirements against the primary notice.
